entry_lines._comment: Primary entry line on CAM_ENTRY_01. Authoritative source for ENTRY/EXIT (CONTRACT.md §13).
entry_lines._direction_note: Crossing from y > 480 to y < 480 is an ENTRY. The reverse is an EXIT.

camera_coverage._comment: Maps each camera_id to the zone_ids it can observe. Update after calibration to reflect actual camera fields of view.
